TaskDescription: Per-game score records for at-home Lumosity cognitive training sessions.

game_name.Description: Name of the Lumosity game played in this record

score.Description: Score the participant achieved in this game instance, as reported by Lumosity

created_at.Description: Timestamp (UTC) at which this game instance was recorded

user_level.Description: Participant's overall level for this game at the time of play, as tracked by Lumosity

session_level.Description: Level reached by the participant within this particular game session

game_nth.Description: Sequential index of the home session (nth Lumosity session) in which this game instance occurred

game_lpi.Description: Lumosity Performance Index (LPI) for this game instance, as calculated by Lumosity; coded n/a for games for which Lumosity does not compute an LPI
